Complete the surprise with a stylish Watch and a heartfelt Birthday or Anniversary Card a perfect blend of taste, elegance, and thoughtful gifting.

🎀 Hamper Includes:
🍫 Chocolate Truffle Cake
🍬 Set of Chocolates
💐 1 Beautiful Bouquet
⌚ 1 Stylish Watch
💌 Birthday / Anniversary Card

✨ One premium hamper. Five beautiful surprises. Endless memories. ✨

🎉 Perfect for birthdays & anniversaries
